sourceBoundary.excluded: No private files, implementation/runtime outputs, source judgments, or sealed/heldout artifacts consulted.

conventions: IDs and source attribution are copied from the public provisional inventory; they do not certify canonical allocation or record kind.

Lifecycle derives from source standing appropriate to the provisional record kind. Null preserves unresolved standing or kind/standing mapping, not a new executable enum. sourceStanding and referenced/described-object standing remain separate. proposedLifecycle is only a labeled prior candidate or future normalization proposal with its basis; it asserts no approved record promotion.

Scope values are semantic applicability proposals, not executable profile identifiers. Null means applicability details are missing; structured notebook scopes preserve independent known applicability with jointWarrant:false. No passage proves genuinely unrestricted global applicability; none receives [].

Subject keys are curator topic proposals. Explicit source missing classification (keyboard-capture) differs from a curator-deferred assignment in this draft (including prior-export, rouge-terms, and earlier-pilot). Omitted keys have a declared classificationStatus/basis; none implies an explicitly empty assignment. No source-backed [] is asserted.

Notebook records retain topic co-membership and per-observation scope facts. A subject conjunction can retrieve such a record but does not prove a jointly tested factual claim; jointWarrant:false preserves this distinction.
All corpus facts are invented synthetic fixture claims, not real-world research findings.

priorHierarchyReview.principle: Source documents need not spell out a subject taxonomy. A deeper hierarchy can be a separately governed curator proposal when its meanings and inherited retrieval warrant are reviewed. Missing literal source taxonomy does not prove that a hierarchy must be flattened. Neither the pilot hierarchy nor the shallower draft is auto-approved.

semanticallyQuestionableEdges.assessment: Requires semantic narrowing, not merely an approval stamp. Design systems can include design language, assets, governance, and non-frontend platforms. Placing the broad subject under frontend may cause every design-systems descendant to inherit frontend classification without sufficient meaning. A clearly defined local frontend-design-systems subject could make this edge defensible.
semanticallyQuestionableEdges.neededEvidence: Company-owned subject definitions and examples demonstrating that this local design-systems subject intentionally denotes a frontend specialization; inspect the inherited meaning before adoption.
semanticallyQuestionableEdges.decision: unresolved; do not auto-approve or automatically flatten

semanticallyQuestionableEdges.assessment: Potential process-versus-object mismatch. Color serialization is an operation or contract that can cover color values beyond design-token entities; it is not inherently a narrower kind of color token. Association with tokens in css-export does not by itself justify a descendant relation.
semanticallyQuestionableEdges.neededEvidence: A local definition restricting color-serialization to token serialization, or a governed restructuring that models token serialization beneath an appropriate serialization subject. Explicitly decide what ancestor membership is intended to assert.
